name: Seedream 5.0 Pro AI Image Generator
tagline: Create and edit images from prompts, photos, sketches and multiple references in one browser workflow.
description:
Seedream 5.0 Pro AI Image Generator is a browser-based image creation and editing tool built on the Seedream model family. It covers text-to-image, image-to-image, sketch-guided generation, multi-reference composition, batch generation and iterative editing in a single workflow.

What it is used for:
- Product visuals and e-commerce imagery built from a product photo plus a written brief.
- Advertising and poster concepts where the composition has to be reshaped several times.
- Social content that needs a consistent look across a set of images.
- Multilingual layouts, where text placement and canvas ratios change per market.
- Structured creative assets that start as a sketch and end as a finished render.

How the workflow goes: you start from a prompt, a reference photo, a sketch, or a mix of references; the tool generates variations, and you continue with targeted edits instead of starting again from zero. Everything runs in the browser, so no local GPU or installation is required.

Pricing is credit-based with one-time packs (Starter $9.90, Creator $29.90, Pro $49.90, Business $99.90). New accounts get 10 free credits after signup, enough for about 3 standard images.

Watch out: the footer says seedream50.pro is an independent website and is not affiliated with ByteDance, Dreamina, Doubao, CapCut, or Volcano Engine. Checked 2026-11-14.
